mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 73 degrees. Tonight, the ISS will be visible for 5 minutes starting at 8:17 PM, rising in the south southwest over Belleville and traveling toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city news, construction continues on the Highway M project with new traffic patterns shifting this week. Additionally, the city has installed a new sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park, created by local artists.

We have plenty to look forward to, including trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they received information regarding a past incident from 2019, which resulted in the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident on September 4 for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
